notes: Strip c: x 3860-5440 plus overlap (x 3560-5740; Amor Place at x~5800 included as a tie). Names: QUEEN CITY (top street, its north line is the plate's top edge), WESTWOOD, ESMONDE ST., NORTHSIDE AVE., SHADWELL ST., CLARA ST., SELIM AVE., LANE ST., LIONEL AVE., GUERNSEY ST., WAYLAND ST., FELTON AVE., TAIT AVE., ASHLEY (AVE.), O-R-A-N-G-E STREET, LEHMAN ROAD. Erford Alley, Rankin Place and Engel Alley are tabs running north off Queen City into the plate edge; their labels are cut off on this scan and were read on the LoC scans 22-31L/22-31R of the same plate. The 60 ft diagonal from Shadwell at y~2575 running SW is printed only 'AVE.' in this strip; named Tomlinson Avenue from the TOMLINSON label further SW on the same diagonal. Large spaced BARRSVILLE (along Tomlinson and at the top), WM. ORANGE.. letters west of Wayland and CHAS. LEHMAN'S SUBDIV'N are subdivision names. Shadwell drifts west from x~4746 (Westwood) to ~4722 (Guernsey); it is labelled WAYLAND ST. south of Guernsey (name change recorded at Guernsey). Esmonde jogs ~125 px at Shadwell. Orange Street: diagonal NE-SW 60 ft from a dead end at (5425,3875) through the Felton/Clara junction, past Tait and Wayland, then winds south (bends listed) and runs SSE as a 40 ft section printed STREET to Lehman Road. Not streets: the railroad trestle crossing Esmonde diagonally, the 60 in. sewer line through Barrsville lot 35 (x~5395), the green/orange/yellow/blue boundary bands (y~3700-3745, x~3880 and x~4200 south of y~5300), the 20 ft strip running SSE to Lehman Road between lots 30 and 47 at x~5310-5590 (unlabelled, looks like a private lane), unnamed narrow alleys between lot rows.
